newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco C.bank withdrew 790 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco C.bank withdrew 790 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: The Moroccan Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 790 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction on Wednesday, a bank official said.
The bank said it received bids totalling 2.080 billion dirhams and allocated 1.970 billion dirhams at 7.0 percent interest rate for one week.
The amount allocated was less than 2.760 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, it said.
The bank satisfied 94.71 percent of demand.
Last week the bank withdrew 124 million dirhams at auction.
The next auction is due to be held on October 9, 1996.
